## Analysis
sol_0047 successfully tested the previously untried Pareto scalarization and found no improvement, so preserving diverse `(n,s,d)` tradeoffs alone does not escape the 66-point basin. Together with failures of unrestricted coordinate, fringe, gap-vector, copy-union, and tensor searches, this suggests the plateau is structural rather than caused by overly greedy acceptance. The most promising untested operation is a many-to-one Freiman-style compression of the best set: deliberately introducing modular collisions may merge substantially more differences than sums, producing a smaller basin inaccessible to ordinary local moves.
